import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int T = 1; // As per original code, T is fixed to 1
        for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
            run(scanner);
        }
        scanner.close();
    }

    static void run(Scanner scanner) {
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        int m = scanner.nextInt();

        int[] arr = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            arr[i] = (int)((long)m * i % n);
        }

        if (m == 0) {
            System.out.println(pow(n, n - 1, MOD));
            return;
        }

        boolean[] visited = new boolean[n];
        int[] count_cycles = new int[n + 1]; // size n+1 for safety
        long total_result = 1;

        for (int start_point = 0; start_point < n; start_point++) {
            if (visited[start_point]) continue;
            int length = 0;
            int current = start_point;
            while (!visited[current]) {
                visited[current] = true;
                current = arr[current];
                length++;
            }
            count_cycles[length]++;
        }

        for (int size = 1; size < n; size++) {
            if (count_cycles[size] != 0) {
                long total = size * (long)count_cycles[size] + (size > 1 ? count_cycles[1] : 0);
                total_result = (total_result * pow(total, count_cycles[size], MOD)) % MOD;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(total_result);
    }

    static long pow(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1;
        base %= mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * base) % mod;
            }
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }
}
